serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: I-Is he alright? Will he reset?
'Nun' Shanice: Of course he is alright! Priestbots never crash! But man, I wish I had someone to show it to at college!
You: B-but isn’t it bad that bot that never crashes just got a bluescreen?
'Nun' Shanice: Well, that's a good question! Are you an IT guy like me?
You: Not really. I just found it weird.
#Nun.Face.nunFaceThinking
'Nun' Shanice: Nice thinking nevertheless.
'Nun' Shanice: Hmm... {{wi}} Now that I think about it…
#Nun.Face.nunFaceSerious
'Nun' Shanice: It may be pretty bad. {{wi}}Horrible actually. 
'Nun' Shanice: It’s taking him a pretty long time to boot again too…
You: What should we do? Can we help him or something?
'Nun' Shanice: I have no idea. 
You: How about calling tech support?
'Nun' Shanice: There is no tech support for Priestbots … They cannot break so there is nothing like that. If hardware starts malfunctioning they even order new parts for themselves. 
This sounds pretty bad… 
Well, it’s not like it concerns me. I can live without this bot just fine.
You: Well, I guess I will be on my way then. 
'Nun' Shanice: You are already going? 
You: Priestbot is down so I can’t ask my question now can I?
'Nun' Shanice: It’s true, b-but! {{wi}}Isn’t it kinda bad leaving him like that?
You: What do you mean by saying ‘bad’? It’s not our fault that he is in this state.
#Nun.Face.nunFaceThinking
'Nun' Shanice: You are not wrong…
#Nun.Face.nunFaceSerious
'Nun' Shanice: ...But I still think we shouldn’t just leave...
You: Huh? That’s weird coming from you. I thought you wanted him gone.
'Nun' Shanice: We had our differences, but seeing him in this state is sad.
So she pities him. She knows him longer than me so I guess they created some kind of bond.
You: I get you, but I have no way of helping, you know? I’m broke and I know nothing about Priestbots.
#Nun.Face.nunFaceNormal
'Nun' Shanice: Don’t worry! I’m broke too, but I’m also an epic IT woman. I’m pretty good at this stuff.
‘Epic’? Only capeshit watching idiots use this word, but whatever, she’s cute.
You: I’m sure you are…
You: So, what are you going to do to fix him?
#Nun.Face.nunFaceThinking
'Nun' Shanice: I have no idea…
#Nun.Face.nunFaceNormal
'Nun' Shanice: Give me some time and I will get it sorted! I will check the internet for help.
You: Didn’t you say that they never break? I doubt there is troubleshooting already done on some website.
'Nun' Shanice: Don’t worry! I will make a thread on /g/.
On G? What is even that? 
Whatever, I’m just gonna pretend like I know this stuff.
You: Yeah, that’s a good idea.
'Nun' Shanice: Thanks! 
You: I will be going now. Good luck with repairs! 
'Nun' Shanice: Be sure to check on my progress! I’m here everyday between 17:00 and 21:00.
We will see about that.
You: Sure! Bye bye~
